summary.title: Building a Custom React Renderer
summary.one_liner: Learn how the little-known react-reconciler npm package lets you write your own React renderer, the same mechanism React DOM and React Native are built on.
takeaways: The npm package react-reconciler can be used to build a custom React renderer.
React DOM and React Native are both built on top of react-reconciler.
The talk builds a simplified version of React DOM as a worked example.
Building a renderer is a route to a deeper understanding of how React works.
summary.summary: This is a talk by Sophie Alpert, published as a YouTube video, about the react-reconciler npm package. It explains that React DOM and React Native are both built on top of this package and that developers can use it to write their own renderer. The talk walks through building a simple version of React DOM. The page text is mostly YouTube interface content, so details beyond the description are not available.
